summary: legal checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for Woot data rights, privacy, and any affiliate or advertising use. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not storage, derivatives, caching, public display, alerts, or commercial rights; current public terms point against the proposed use. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Keep the site private, leave rights outreach unsent, and permit only bounded read-only evidence work. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere may continue within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks can close. The source-rights, data-flow, consent/GA4, and logs/vendor/incident tasks remain open because the available artifacts are partial and do not evidence the required rights, settings, retention, deletion, processor, or incident controls. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle to the existing checklist containing the authoritative rights record, repository/config data-flow and retention table, deployed consent and GA4 settings capture, and log/vendor/incident inventory. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, change production, or add data collection.

Compliance and data-quality disposition: do not treat the technical compliance scan as certification. The baseline reports 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown across 61 sites, including 19 banner/accept/reject/GA4 failures and 4 privacy and terms findings. Data quality is green for registry, operational checkouts, analytics, SEO, AI usage, and revenue ingestion; revenue attribution is yellow because $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21 is in an aggregate provider row. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, or causal lift. Missing telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth; launch and security-sensitive release gates remain unchanged.
